theory.title: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales
theory.explanation: Usa conectores narrativos como initially (al principio), shortly afterwards (poco después), eventually (finalmente/con el tiempo), by then (para entonces) e in the meantime (mientras tanto) para organizar los acontecimientos y facilitar el seguimiento de una historia.
theory.tip: Combina conectores de inicio, secuencia, simultaneidad y resultado.

patterns.label: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales · 1
examples:
Initially, the presenter was nervous.
→ Al principio, el presentador estaba nervioso.

patterns.label: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales · 2
patterns.pattern: Shortly afterwards, the lights went out.
examples:
Shortly afterwards, the lights went out.
→ Poco después, se apagaron las luces.

patterns.label: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales · 3
patterns.pattern: In the meantime, the audience waited quietly.
examples:
In the meantime, the audience waited quietly.
→ Mientras tanto, el público esperaba en silencio.

patterns.label: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales · 4
patterns.pattern: By then, the producer had found a solution.
examples:
By then, the producer had found a solution.
→ Para entonces, el productor había encontrado una solución.

patterns.label: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales · 5
examples:
Eventually, the show started.
→ Finalmente, empezó el espectáculo.

patterns.label: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales · 6
patterns.pattern: A few moments later, the music stopped.
examples:
A few moments later, the music stopped.
→ Unos instantes después, la música se detuvo.

patterns.label: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales · 7
patterns.pattern: Meanwhile, the camera crew changed position.
examples:
Meanwhile, the camera crew changed position.
→ Mientras tanto, el equipo de cámaras cambió de posición.

patterns.label: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales · 8
patterns.pattern: After a while, the guests returned.
examples:
After a while, the guests returned.
→ Al cabo de un rato, los invitados regresaron.

patterns.label: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales · 9
patterns.pattern: In the end, the interview was a success.
examples:
In the end, the interview was a success.
→ Al final, la entrevista fue un éxito.

patterns.label: Secuencia narrativa y conectores temporales · 10
patterns.pattern: From that moment on, the programme became popular.
examples:
From that moment on, the programme became popular.
→ A partir de ese momento, el programa se hizo popular.

content.passage: Initially, the live programme was running smoothly. Shortly afterwards, the sound system stopped working. In the meantime, the presenter spoke to the audience while the technicians checked the equipment. By then, the producer had contacted the studio team. Eventually, the sound returned and the show continued. In the end, viewers praised the presenter for staying calm.

items.prompt: Tell a short story using initially and eventually.
items.modelAnswer: I enjoy different kinds of media because they help me learn about the world and relax. I usually choose programmes that are informative and well presented. I also like discussing films and documentaries with friends because we often have different opinions. Although some online stories are not reliable, I try to check the source before sharing them. In the future, I think media will become more personalised, but good journalism will remain important.

content.audioTranscript: A: Did you watch the new documentary last night? B: Yes, the audience really enjoyed it. A: The presenter was excellent. B: I haven't seen the next episode yet. A: I read a positive review online. B: Was it from a reliable source? A: Yes, although there was one advertisement during the break. B: I watched it on a streaming service. A: What's your opinion of the series? B: It's a very interesting programme.
